tool.name: MGnify: MAPseq to BIOM OTU table
tool.description: Summarize MAPseq output as a BIOM-compatible OTU table plus Krona text

param.label: Database label
param.help: Column header for the count column in the output table (e.g. SILVA-SSU, PR2, ITSoneDB, UNITE). Labels starting with UNITE or PR2 omit the taxid column.

param.label: Include taxid column?
param.help: With --taxid the main table gains a taxid column and a second table without taxids is produced (as the MGnify amplicon pipeline does)

tool.help:
**MAPseq to BIOM OTU table** ----------------------------
Wraps the ``mapseq2biom`` command of the `MGnify pipelines toolkit`_ (the same tool the MGnify amplicon pipeline calls). It summarizes a MAPseq classification output (``.mseq``) as reads-per-taxon, joins the OTU IDs from the database's OTU table, and writes:
- a BIOM-compatible OTU table (``# OTU ID / label / taxonomy [/ taxid]``), - the same table without taxIDs (when *Include taxid column* is enabled), - a Krona text file (``count<tab>rank1<tab>rank2...``) suitable for ``ktImportText`` (e.g. the *Krona pie chart* tool).
Labels starting with ``UNITE`` or ``PR2`` omit the taxid column from the main table.
.. _MGnify pipelines toolkit: https://github.com/EBI-Metagenomics/mgnify-pipelines-toolkit
